title: Svartsengi (Sundhnúkur crater row) eruption 1 Apr 2025: SIMULATED fire-fountain heights by fissure segment
centroid_method: mid-point of the 700 m fissure reported at 10:35 UTC between 63d51.435N 22d24.856W and 63d51.616N 22d24.586W (IMO VONA); approx. +/-0.003 deg
source: Rhodes et al. (2026) Bull. Volcanol. 88:89, doi:10.1007/s00445-026-02006-3; supplement ESM2
model: model: h(t) = Hmax_seg * (1-exp(-B t)) exp(-C t) / peak, t = seconds since segment opening; rise-decay form of Rhodes et al. (2026) Eq. 2 | B = 0.03806 s^-1, C = 1.0680e-04 s^-1 (refit of Eq. 2 to all 37 segments of the four measured eruptions pooled; A = 0.677); curve peak at 2.6 min after opening | scaled so each segment peaks at its Hmax_seg (the pulse maximum). The fitted mean trend is A x these values. Model calibrated only on the first ~3 h of fountaining; later values are extrapolation. | eruption Hmax = 55 m (first segment), weighted mean of two regressions on the four measured eruptions (Dec 2023 93 m, Jan 2024 56 m, Mar 2024 124 m, Aug 2024 133 m): | H = -56.4 + 58.3 log10(Q_peak) [resid SD 15 m] -> 51 m with Q = 70 m3/s (~70 m3/s peak effusion assumed: 0.4 million m3 erupted over ~5 h (mean ~22 m3/s) x ~3 for peak/mean) | H = 46.6 + 18.6 L_fissure_km [resid SD 28 m] -> 69 m with L = 1.2 km | later segments: Hmax_seg = ratio x eruption Hmax, ratio = median of observed (segment max / eruption max) for segments opening <30 min (0.45), 30-120 min (0.39), >120 min (0.14) after onset (Rhodes et al. supplement) | end-of-activity taper (not part of Rhodes model): heights scaled linearly to zero between 2025-04-01T13:40:00Z and 2025-04-01T15:00:00Z (activity decreased 13:40-14:40, none visible by 15:00; IMO)

segments.name: seg1
segments.basis: initial fissure N of the Grindavik barrier

segments.name: seg2
segments.basis: fissure through the barrier by ~10:00 UTC

segments.name: seg3
segments.basis: erupting inside the barrier by 10:24 UTC (IMO)

segments.name: seg4
segments.basis: five segments and 1.2 km by 12:35 UTC; opening set to mid-window 10:35-12:35
